name: HubSpot
summary: HubSpot CRM records (contacts, companies, deals, tickets), CRM search, deal pipelines and stages, and owners through the CRM v3 API.

token.description: a HubSpot private app or service key access token with the crm.objects.*.read scopes needed

notes: Records return only default properties unless 'properties' names the ones wanted; list the available ones with hubspot.properties.list.
Paging is a cursor: send paging.next.after from the previous answer as 'after'. No paging.next means the last page.
Deal stages and pipelines come back as internal ids (e.g. dealstage 'appointmentscheduled'); map them to labels with hubspot.pipelines.list.
Search is limited to 5 requests per second per account and 10,000 results per query; newly changed records take a few moments to appear in search.

endpoints.name: List CRM records
endpoints.summary: A page of records of one object type (contacts, companies, deals, tickets...).

objectType.description: CRM object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets, or another object's name or type id.

properties.description: Comma-separated properties to return; only defaults come back otherwise.

propertiesWithHistory.description: Comma-separated properties to return with their history.

associations.description: Comma-separated object types to return associated record ids for.

endpoints.name: Get a CRM record
endpoints.summary: One record by its record id, or by a unique property such as email with idProperty.

objectType.description: CRM object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets, or another object's name or type id.

recordId.description: Record id, or the unique property value when idProperty is set.

idProperty.description: Look up by this unique property instead of the record id, e.g. email for contacts.

properties.description: Comma-separated properties to return; only defaults come back otherwise.

propertiesWithHistory.description: Comma-separated properties to return with their history.

associations.description: Comma-separated object types to return associated record ids for.

endpoints.name: Search CRM records
endpoints.summary: Filter, sort and full-text search records of one object type, e.g. open deals over an amount or contacts at a company domain.

objectType.description: CRM object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets, or another object's name or type id.

filterGroups.description: Up to 5 groups (OR'd) of up to 6 filters (AND'd), 18 filters total. A filter is {propertyName, operator, value} with operator EQ, NEQ, LT, LTE, GT, GTE, BETWEEN (value + highValue), IN / NOT_IN (values), HAS_PROPERTY, NOT_HAS_PROPERTY, CONTAINS_TOKEN, NOT_CONTAINS_TOKEN. associations.{objectType} filters by associated record.

query.description: Text searched across the object's default text properties.

limit.description: Results per page, default 10, at most 200.

notes: Archived records never appear. IN/NOT_IN values on string properties must be lowercase; enumeration properties match case-sensitively.
The request body may be at most 3,000 characters; paging past 10,000 results answers 400.

endpoints.name: List an object's properties
endpoints.summary: Every property defined on an object type, with its internal name, label, type and options.

objectType.description: CRM object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets, or another object's name or type id.

endpoints.name: List pipelines and stages
endpoints.summary: Every pipeline for an object type (deals, tickets) with its stages' ids, labels and order.

objectType.description: deals or tickets (or another object with pipelines).

endpoints.name: List owners
endpoints.summary: Users who can own records, with owner id, user id, name, email and teams.
notes: Use the owner id (id) to look up or assign owners; userId is only for the settings API and fails as an owner.
